$comment: Worlds Without Number coverage register for #1101. Free SRD is CC0; Deluxe and free-book-only procedures are blocked where no lawful text is on this host.

source.rights: CC0 1.0 — SRD text only, not the commercial book or protected setting.
source.deluxe: Not available on this host; blocked, never synthesised.
source.free_book: The free-book mirror cited by #1101 returned HTTP 403 on 2026-11-03.

tabletop_legend.cwn_delegated: Tabletop uses the CWN procedure; WWN adds no tabletop rule.
